name: Postmark
solves: Provides the official Node.js SDK for Postmark's transactional email API with templates, batches, inbound email, message streams, and delivery/bounce webhooks focused on reliable inbox delivery.
best_for: Transactional email (receipts, password resets, notifications) where deliverability is the priority
Apps that want separate message streams for transactional vs broadcast mail
Teams that prefer Postmark's focused ESP over general marketing platforms
Node services needing typed templates, batch sending, and webhook event handling
skip_when: You need a free-forever high-volume tier — Postmark is commercial after trial
You want React-first email authoring tightly coupled to Resend
You must self-host SMTP with Nodemailer and no vendor
You primarily send marketing/newsletter campaigns rather than transactional mail
You are standardized on AWS SES for cost and IAM reasons
